record.body:
## Description

Prove the phase exit criteria hold together: contract resolves both types, skills stay consistent, CLI lifecycle passes, and the dashboard Backlog panel works through the app entry point.

## Approach

Run the phase-scoped commands only (no full suite):
1. `uv run --with textual --with pytest python -m pytest tests/test_backlog_item.py -q` — CLI integration.
2. `uv run --with textual --with pytest python -m pytest tests/test_contract_self_consistency.py -q`
3. `uv run --with pytest python -m pytest tests/test_skill_contract_consistency.py tests/test_assess_routing.py -q`
4. `uv run --with textual --with pytest python -m pytest tests/test_dashboard_model.py tests/test_dashboard_app.py -q -k backlog`

Confirm feedback engage rules remain, backlog is not in Needs you, and Backlog panel promote/dismiss use the CLI. Prefer failing with evidence over drive-by product edits.
record.subject: verify-backlog-capture
